written_by: Editor's list. Not taken from any source. To be corrected by trip reports.

items.item: Rain suit that fits over riding gear
items.reason: Hill weather turns quickly, and the monsoon is heavy
Hill stations are cold after dark, even when the plains are hot
Ghat roads have few shops between towns
Mist and early dusk under the trees
Long descents with hairpin bends are hard on pads and fluid
Forest gates and small stalls often take only cash

items.item: Licence, registration, insurance and pollution certificate
items.reason: Asked for at forest and state check posts

items.item: Any pass or permit this route needs

items.reason: Forest stretches have no stalls, and stopping may not be allowed
Many hill districts ban plastic and fine for litter

items.item: This route saved to your phone
items.reason: Network drops in the ghats and forests
